[LSER.6.12.1] A label name used in `as <label>` must not
match any slot name on the schema being observed. The
compiler must reject the series declaration at declaration
time. This ensures that for any binding `t`, the dotted
chain `t.foo` is unambiguous: either `foo` is a slot name
(slot read or slot designator) or a label name — never both.
